# Course Compare

> Pick up to three HAZWOPER, refresher, waste or data center courses and compare length, price, regulation and audience side by side, then enroll in the one that fits.

Course Compare (https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hr TSD Operations, 8-Hour Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Initial training for general site workers. Enroll: https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). Initial training for occasional and low-exposure workers. Enroll: https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER - RCRA TSD Operations Training](https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-rcra-tsd-operations-training): $229.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(p) / RCRA. Initial training for TSD facility workers. Enroll: https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-rcra-tsd-operations-training?buy=582
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual refresher. Enroll: https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher - State-Plan Versions Available](https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-state-plan-versions-available): $84.99 per seat, 8 Hours, State-plan equivalents of federal OSHA standard (see parent course). The annual refresher with state-plan versions. Enroll: https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-state-plan-versions-available?buy=900
- [Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026)](https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $219.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(e). The 40-hour written to California's 8 CCR 5192. Enroll: https://compare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=577
